actions.add_member_to_space.description: Add an existing member to a specific space by their email.
The email address of the member to add to the space.
actions.create_comment.description: Creates a new comment on a post.
actions.create_comment.props.parent_comm: ID of the comment to reply to. Leave empty if not a reply.
actions.create_comment.props.skip_notifi: Skip sending notifications for this comment?
actions.create_post.description: Creates a new post in a specific space.
actions.create_post.props.published_at.d: If status is 'scheduled', provide the future date and time for publishing.
actions.create_post.props.skip_notificat: Prevent notifications from being sent for this post?
actions.create_post.props.text_body.desc: Simple plain text content for the post. Used if 'Tiptap Body JSON' is not provided.
actions.create_post.props.tiptap_body_js: Full TipTap JSON object for the post body. If provided, 'Post Body (Plain Text)' is ignored.
actions.create_post.props.user_email.des: Email of an existing community member to create this post as. If empty, posts as the authenticated admin.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.find_member_by_email.description: Finds a community member by their email address.
actions.find_member_by_email.props.email: The email address of the member to find.
actions.get_member_details.description: Fetches the full profile details for a specific community member.
actions.get_post_details.description: Retrieves the complete details of a specific post.

triggers.new_member_added.description: Triggers when a new member is added to the community.
triggers.new_post_created.description: Triggers when a new post is created in a specific space.
